idea_text: Mobile app for tracking daily health habits: water intake, sleep, exercise, medication. Gamification with streaks and achievements. Integration with Apple Health and Google Fit. Subscription model: free tier (3 habits), premium ($4.99/mo, unlimited + analytics).
target_audience: Health-conscious adults aged 25-45 who want to build better habits but find existing apps too complicated or too gamified.

idea_text: Two-sided marketplace for freelance designers. Clients post projects, designers submit proposals. Escrow payment system. Portfolio showcase. Skill-based matching algorithm. Must launch in 3 verticals: logo design, web design, illustration.
target_audience: Small business owners who need design work done affordably, and freelance designers looking for consistent client flow.

idea_text: Online learning platform for coding bootcamps. Live instructor-led sessions, auto-graded coding challenges, peer code review. Must support 500 concurrent students. Progress tracking and certificates. Integration with GitHub for code submissions.
target_audience: Coding bootcamp students (career changers) and bootcamp operators who need a modern LMS with real coding integration.
